Name: Nicolas
Summary: Nicolas was one of the seven men chosen to serve tables in the Jerusalem church, and the only one Acts describes as a proselyte, a Gentile convert to Judaism from Antioch.
KeyStory: Nicolas, a proselyte of Antioch, was chosen among the seven, a Gentile convert serving a Jewish church's widows.
LifeLesson: The gospel's first officers already crossed the Jew-Gentile line. Nicolas served widows not his own by birth.
